title: Player profile
description: Career-spanning profile for one player. Position assignment follows a three-layer rule: (1) recency-weighted actual position from Liverpool minutes if any exist, else recency-weighted position from prior club(s); (2) overlaid with the manager's positional-deployment prior for that player archetype; (3) updated by actual observed 2026/27 lineups as they happen, using the same posterior-update mechanism as the tactical metrics.

listed_positions.description: Raw position tags as listed by the source (e.g. FotMob's 'AM, DM, RW, RB, CM, LW' for Szoboszlai).

position_estimate.description: The derived, recency-weighted position estimate actually used by the model -- distinct from listed_positions, which is just raw source data.

basis.description: Which layer of the three-layer rule produced this estimate.

career_stints.description: Ordered oldest-to-newest. Each stint's positions/minutes are what feed the recency weighting -- most recent stint weighted highest.

playstyle_metrics.description: Per-90 stats from the most recent complete season available, used as the individual-level input into squad projections. Sparse by design -- fields absent if the source didn't have them (e.g. a young academy player with few minutes).
